title: 롤백 절차
code:
#!/bin/bash
# Rollback to previous version

echo "Rolling back to version $1..."

# Get previous version
PREV_VERSION=$(git tag -l | sort -V | tail -n 2 | head -n 1)

# Checkout
git checkout $PREV_VERSION

# Rebuild and redeploy
npm run build
npm run deploy
